stale is a boolean and staleReason carries the sentence. The finding is worse than it reads: the failure path in release.ps1 wrote the whole sentence into `stale`, and the dashboard counts a stale project with a strict `stale === true`, so a card recorded stale WITH its reason did not register as stale at all and the counter read zero. One field doing two jobs, two consumers disagreeing about its type. The failure path sets the flag true and the reason beside it, a successful write clears the reason so it cannot outlive the failure it described, project-status.py carries staleReason to the public card, and the badge uses it as its title when present while a flag with no reason keeps the generic sentence. check-status-json.ps1 asserts both types rather than trusting the writers: proved by planting a string in stale, which failed at exit 1 naming the file and the type, and the card was restored and the check reads clean.
